6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: C. de la Beneficencia, 13, Centro, 28004 Madrid, Spain, Madrid
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

```json
    "addressLocality": "Madrid",

  },
  "telephone": "",
  "priceRange": "€€"

```

# COMPLETE WEBSITE BUILD SPECIFICATION: TASQUITA DEL MAR

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
- **Business Name**: Tasquita del mar
- **Industry / Category**: Bar
- **Location**: C. del Mar, 23, bajo izquierdo, Ciutat Vella, 46003 València, Valencia, Spain, Valencia, , 
- **Target Audience**: Local residents, discerning neighborhood clients, and mobile searchers in Valencia.
- **Reputation Status**: 4.6 Stars across 2117 customer reviews.

---

## 2. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & VISUAL SYSTEM
- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.

  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`

  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)

---

2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Bar at its Finest in Valencia"

4. **Why Choose Tasquita del mar**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: C. del Mar, 23, bajo izquierdo, Ciutat Vella, 46003 València, Valencia, Spain, Valencia
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:960 22 14 68` trigger for mobile visitors.

```json
    "addressLocality": "Valencia",
    "addressRegion": "",
    "addressCountry": ""
  },
  "telephone": "960 22 14 68",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```

---

   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: C/ de la Corretgeria, 33, Ciutat Vella, 46001 València, Valencia, Spain, Valencia
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "Rincón 33",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "C/ de la Corretgeria, 33, Ciutat Vella, 46001 València, Valencia, Spain",
    "addressLocality": "Valencia",
    "addressRegion": "",
    "addressCountry": ""
  },
  "telephone": "667 71 78 39",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

direction1.title: Modern Craft & Quiet Luxury
direction1.tagline: Refined, timeless aesthetic emphasizing artisanal mastery and premium customer care.
direction1.designPhilosophy: Clean generous whitespace, subtle warm stone and slate tones, editorial typography, and high-contrast hero photography highlighting meticulous attention to detail.

typography.rationale: The serif headline evokes established prestige and artisanal heritage, balanced with a hyper-legible modern sans-serif body.

direction1.layoutPhilosophy: Asymmetric editorial grid with prominent full-width visual banner, floating quote cards, and clear sticky navigation.
direction1.heroConcept: Atmospheric imagery of MVP Barber Studio's craft with an elegant headline: "The Art of Barber shop in Madrid."
direction1.imageTreatment: Rich, natural lighting, duotone micro-accents, deep blacks with subtle warm highlights.
direction1.conversionStrategy: Low-friction "Reserve an Experience" primary CTA paired with immediate WhatsApp quick-chat inquiry.

direction2.title: Dynamic, High-Conversion Urban
direction2.tagline: Energetic, direct, and mobile-optimized for swift client acquisition and fast booking.
direction2.designPhilosophy: Bold high-contrast accents, electric blue and emerald trust indicators, quick-glance pricing chips, and instant touch-first interactions.

typography.rationale: Geometric, contemporary sans-serif with strong horizontal rhythm that drives immediate visual confidence.

direction2.layoutPhilosophy: Single-page fluid landing page with modular cards, prominent pricing pill badges, and sticky bottom booking drawer on mobile.
direction2.heroConcept: "Top-Rated Barber shop in Madrid — Book in 30 Seconds." Instant calendar and call buttons.
direction2.imageTreatment: Crisp action photography, vibrant saturation, subtle radial glow accents behind hero cards.
direction2.conversionStrategy: Instant mobile click-to-call, tap-to-WhatsApp, and automated availability inquiry form.

direction3.title: Warm Community & Local Heritage

# COMPLETE WEBSITE BUILD SPECIFICATION: IMAGE HAIR SALON AND BARBER SHOP

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
- **Business Name**: IMAGE HAIR SALON AND BARBER SHOP
- **Industry / Category**: Barber shop
- **Location**: Carrer del Carme, 97, Ciutat Vella, 08001 Barcelona, Spain, Barcelona, , 
- **Target Audience**: Local residents, discerning neighborhood clients, and mobile searchers in Barcelona.
- **Reputation Status**: 4.8 Stars across 216 customer reviews.
- **Core Value Proposition**: Premier artisanal craftsmanship, personal customer care, transparent service packages, and effortless mobile booking.
- **Service Package Tier**: Starting at €500 with optional €40/mo managed hosting and high-speed local CDN.

---

## 2. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & VISUAL SYSTEM
- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.
- **Palette**:
  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`
  - Card & Surface: `#111827`
  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)
  - Secondary Accent: `#06b6d4` (Cyan Glow)
  - Text Primary: `#f8fafc`
  - Text Muted: `#94a3b8`
  - Border Highlights: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).
  - Body: Crisp, highly legible sans-serif (`Inter`, 16px base, 1.6 line-height).
- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

## 3. PAGE STRUCTURE & SECTIONS

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)
1. **Sticky Header**:
   - IMAGE HAIR SALON AND BARBER SHOP logo / brand mark
   - Nav links: Services, About, Reviews, Location, FAQ
   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (634 16 97 31)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Barber shop at its Finest in Barcelona"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.8/5 Stars by local clients in Barcelona"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose IMAGE HAIR SALON AND BARBER SHOP**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Carrer del Carme, 97, Ciutat Vella, 08001 Barcelona, Spain, Barcelona
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

## 4. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS & INTEGRATIONS
- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:634 16 97 31` trigger for mobile visitors.
- **Direct WhatsApp Chat**: `https://wa.me/...` pre-filled message ("Hi IMAGE HAIR SALON AND BARBER SHOP, I would like to inquire about...").
- **LocalBusiness Schema (JSON-LD)**:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "IMAGE HAIR SALON AND BARBER SHOP",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Carrer del Carme, 97, Ciutat Vella, 08001 Barcelona, Spain",
    "addressLocality": "Barcelona",
    "addressRegion": "",
    "addressCountry": ""
  },
  "telephone": "634 16 97 31",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

---

- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.
- **Palette**:
  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`

---

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)

   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (660 64 98 62)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Bar at its Finest in Valencia"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.8/5 Stars by local clients in Valencia"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose Mientras Tanto - restobar • tapas • drinks**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: C/ de los Cordellats, 6, bajo izquierda, Ciutat Vella, 46001 Valencia, Spain, Valencia
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

## 4. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS & INTEGRATIONS
- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:660 64 98 62` trigger for mobile visitors.
- **Direct WhatsApp Chat**: `https://wa.me/...` pre-filled message ("Hi Mientras Tanto - restobar • tapas • drinks, I would like to inquire about...").
- **LocalBusiness Schema (JSON-LD)**:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "Mientras Tanto - restobar • tapas • drinks",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "C/ de los Cordellats, 6, bajo izquierda, Ciutat Vella, 46001 Valencia, Spain",
    "addressLocality": "Valencia",
    "addressRegion": "",
    "addressCountry": ""
  },
  "telephone": "660 64 98 62",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.
